==== input.vue (1 finding) ====
<template><div class="border-(--root-b) border-(--other)">x</div></template>
                      ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
!!! tailwindcss/enforces-shorthand: The class 'border-(--root-b)' can be written as 'border-middle'

=== FIXED (--fix) ===
<template><div class="border-middle border-(--other)">x</div></template>

(same as --fix)
